description: This file defines a PHPUnit test case class EmployeeDetailedModelTest for testing the EmployeeDetailedModel within the OrangeHRM system's PIM Api Model. It includes a test method that validates the output of converting an Employee object to an array.

classes.name: EmployeeDetailedModelTest
classes.description: A test suite for the EmployeeDetailedModel class, validating its toArray method output.
